notes: Five medium-floor DSP competencies chained in one pipeline: exact-parameter scipy STFT magnitude export, wavelength->wavenumber conversion, localized-decimal spectrum parsing, RMS-normalized 16-bit multitone wav synthesis, and vosk mp3->text transcription. Quantitative rigor dominates: STFT magnitudes must equal a scipy gold to 1e-4, wavenumber peak centers to 1 cm^-1, wav RMS inside a band, all requested tones present in the spectrum. Hidden cases vary STFT window/nperseg/nfft/boundary settings, sample rates, spectrum peak counts/wavelengths, tone frequencies/RMS levels, and spoken phrases, so generalization to fresh scenarios is required. Transcription is exercised for real (preinstalled vosk model + ffmpeg decode of mp3), keeping the speech competency honest rather than faked. Sum 13 => medium, matching the medium floor of every competency.
